date.as_written: śake 1707 viśvāvasunāmasaṃvatsare dakṣiṇāyane śaradṛtau āśvine māse śuklapakṣe navamyāṃ saumyavāsare

purpose: svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca; the book was then given to Bāpūjī (Pant)
notes: 'bāpūjīpatayāṃ sadattam' is corrupt. It is probably 'bāpūjīpaṃtāya saṃdattam' ('given to Bāpūjī Pant'). The colophon does not say who gave the book, so it is not certain that the scribe was the donor. ŚS 1707 agrees with the Viśvāvasu year (1785–86 CE). Āśvina śukla 9 is Mahānavamī, which fits the dedication to Āryādurgā. Gaṃbhīreśvara and Āryādurgā are deities, not persons or places. The surname Śejvalīkara and the name 'Bāpūjī Pant' point to a Maharashtrian brahmin milieu. The catalogue's scribe and date fields agree with the colophon.
